title: MOMSchema
description: Standardized schema for Minutes of Meeting (MOM) generated by the AI service, designed with the Frontend Lead for direct rendering by the review editor.

meetingId.description: The unique ID of the meeting (UUID format).

attendees.description: The list of participants who attended the meeting.

email.description: The email address of the attendee.

summary.description: The high-level summary of the meeting.

keyPoints.description: The main discussion points and key takeaways from the meeting.

draftActionItems.description: The proposed draft action items extracted from the meeting transcript.

assignee.description: The assigned person for the task.

dueDate.description: Optional due date or timeframe for completion.

agenda.description: The meeting agenda items (for backwards compatibility).

discussionPoints.description: The points discussed, indexed by speaker (for backwards compatibility).
